knowledgeBase.answer: Rooted Vitality is a modern connection platform that bridges holistic practitioners and patients. We help clients find trusted wellness professionals and help practitioners reach clients who value their work.

Holistic medicine treats the whole person—body, mind, spirit, and environment—rather than just symptoms. It emphasizes prevention, natural healing, and the interconnection between all aspects of health.
Booking is simple: Create your account, complete your wellness profile, review matched practitioners, and select your preferred time. You'll receive confirmation and contact info immediately.
Start by exploring wellness resources and articles. When ready, browse practitioners by specialty and location, then book a consultation with someone who resonates with you.
A care request is how you tell practitioners what you're looking for. It describes your wellness goals and helps practitioners determine if they're a good fit for you.
Look for relevant credentials, read reviews, trust your instincts, and take time to get to know practitioners before committing. Your safety and comfort come first.
Your optional wellness profile helps practitioners understand your needs better. It's used only by practitioners you've connected with and is completely private.
Your first consultation is about getting to know each other and seeing if there's a good fit. Come prepared with questions and be open to discussing your wellness goals.
Building long-term relationships with practitioners helps you get better results. Many clients work with multiple practitioners in different areas for comprehensive wellness.
Rooted Vitality uses a membership-based model. You keep 100% of your earnings—we take no commission. You control your services, pricing, areas, and format. Build direct client relationships.
Create your profile with your background, philosophy, credentials, rates, and availability. Set up your match settings to define specialties and coverage areas. Start connecting with clients.
knowledgeBase.articleTitle: Managing Your Practice on Rooted Vitality

knowledgeBase.answer: Your profile is your digital storefront. Include a professional photo, detailed bio, credentials, services, rates, and availability. Complete profiles get more visibility.
Set your own rates based on experience and local market. You control all pricing and can adjust per specialty. All earnings go directly to you—no commission.
Choose specialties matching your training and expertise. Each specialty can be toggled on/off independently. Configure pricing per specialty if needed.
Choose how you work: in-office, housecalls, or virtual. Define travel radius, zipcodes, or service states. You have complete control over your coverage.
When clients reach out, respond thoughtfully and promptly. Review their wellness profile, be genuine and professional. You're building partnerships, not just closing sales.
Review match requests and decide if the fit is right for you. Accept to connect in your inbox or decline with no hard feelings. Both sides choose freely.
Connect your CRM to sync client data automatically. Supported platforms: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, HighLevel, ServiceTitan, mHelpDesk, and Zoho CRM.
